finalText:
**Root cause: `dep-4471` set connection-per-request.** The gateway pool is size 20. It saturated 19 seconds after that deploy finished.

Window runs `02:14:18Z` to `03:59:27Z`, the log end. Still firing. 530 of 636 requests failed, or 83%.

One gap worth flagging. `/health` returned 200 on all 180 checks, so the page came 67 minutes late. Full writeup in [HANDOFF.md](HANDOFF.md).

Next: roll back `dep-4471`.
